note: 17 verified-unrostered targets from Sleeper's top-200 trending adds, Week 1 usage and Week 2 projections (REST, cache-busted), cross-checked against all 12 rosters. Three claims planned: Tampa Bay DEF, Caleb Douglas, Devaughn Vele.

targets.hook: Hosts Cleveland; your MIN D plays at 59-point Chicago
targets.why: Tampa Bay hosts Cleveland in Week 2 (ESPN schedule), a team Jacksonville blew out in Week 1 and that lost Dylan Sampson to a knee injury expected to cost extended time (nfl-events feed, Sept. 14). Sleeper projects Tampa Bay's defense for 9.8 in this league's scoring, the best on the wire.
targets.asset: 9.8 projected vs 6.4 for your Minnesota D, which plays at Chicago the week after the Bears put up 59
targets.my_team_impact: A straight swap at DEF for about 3.4 projected points. DEF scoring here runs from +10 for a shutout to -4 for 35 allowed, so the matchup is most of the value.
targets.confidence_why: Matchup streams are reliable on average and noisy in any single week; no role risk involved.
targets.competition: Sleeper's #5 trending add league-wide, but no rival's DEF is hurt and nobody can see a need for it on their roster.
targets.bid: unpriced -- year one, no bidding history in this league yet. A DEF stream should go for the minimum; don't let it compete with the WR claims for money.
targets.drop: Minnesota Vikings DEF -- at Chicago this week; re-add a defense by matchup next week.

targets.hook: Rookie at 91% of snaps, 7 targets, 5-94 in debut
targets.why: Third-round rookie played 51 of 56 snaps and caught 5 of 7 targets for 94 yards in his debut; RotoWire expects him to lead Miami's receivers in snaps by season's end (RotoWire, Sept. 14; FantasyPros, Sept. 15). Sleeper's #2 trending add league-wide.
targets.my_team_impact: Bench WR with a full-time role, next up behind Johnston (8.3) at FLEX. Replaces Jonathon Brooks, who ran 13 of 68 snaps.
targets.confidence_why: Full-time snaps are the sturdier signal, but it is one game from a rookie.
targets.competition: Eight of your eleven opponents carry an injured WR, and all twelve teams still have the full 100.
targets.bid: unpriced -- year one, no bidding history in this league yet. 12 teams on 100 FAAB chase a thinner pool than a 10-team league, so a price that looks high elsewhere may be the one that clears here.
targets.drop: Jonathon Brooks -- 13 of 68 snaps behind Carolina's starter; the RB room still has Love, Etienne, White and Henderson (IR) behind it.

targets.hook: 82 of 90 snaps and 9 targets with Tyson out into October
targets.why: Caught 7 of 9 targets for 69 yards and a touchdown while playing 82 of 90 snaps; rookie Jordyn Tyson's hamstring keeps him out until early October (FantasyPros, Sept. 15; RotoWire, Sept. 14). Sleeper's #1 trending add league-wide.
targets.my_team_impact: Just under Johnston (8.3) for the second FLEX and a real role for the weeks Tyson is out. Replaces Cyrus Allen, who played 1 snap.
targets.confidence_why: One game of volume, though Tyson's absence gives the role a known multi-week window.
targets.competition: Same WR demand as Douglas; Eharmon1986 owns Tyson and has the most direct reason to bid.
targets.bid: unpriced -- year one, no bidding history in this league yet. He's the #1 add nationally, so expect this to be the most contested claim on the board.
targets.drop: Cyrus Allen -- 1 snap, 1 target in Week 1.

targets.hook: Projects 18.1, well above Daniel Jones as your QB2
targets.why: Houston's starter threw for 274 yards and 2 TDs in Week 1 and hosts Cincinnati in Week 2, a defense that allowed the most catches to tight ends in the league last season (FantasyPros, Sept. 15). Sleeper projects 18.1.
targets.asset: Full-time starter, 16.5 pts in Week 1; 18.1 projected
targets.my_team_impact: Maye starts. If you're carrying a QB2 anyway, Stroud (18.1) beats Jones (14.7) by 3.4 and is the better bye cover.
targets.confidence_why: Stroud's role is certain; whether a QB2 is worth a bench spot is the open question.
targets.competition: LaPray0814 (Darnold Out) and WreckingCrew09 (Murray Out) both need a starting QB now.
targets.bid: n/a -- watch; a swap for Jones only if you keep a QB2
targets.drop: Daniel Jones, as a like-for-like QB2 swap.

targets.hook: Route parity with DeVonta Smith; 73 yds, TD on 4 targets
targets.why: Ran nearly identical snap and route counts to DeVonta Smith in Week 1 (50 of 55 snaps), with a 64-yard catch and a 9-yard touchdown on 4 targets (FantasyPros, Sept. 15).
targets.my_team_impact: The fallback if either WR claim above misses.
targets.confidence_why: The routes are real; the 14.3 points came from two plays.
targets.competition: Eight WR-needy opponents; sbbroom owns DeVonta Smith.
targets.bid: n/a -- watch; fallback claim if a PURSUE misses

targets.hook: Maye's WR with A.J. Brown out six weeks
targets.why: A.J. Brown went on IR with a high-ankle sprain expected to cost six weeks (Rapoport, Sept. 14). Hollins ran 4 routes in the first half and 22 in the second after Brown went down, catching 4 of 5 for a team-high 51 yards (Fantasy Footballers, Sept. 14).
targets.asset: 50 of 71 snaps, mostly after the injury; projects 7.1
targets.my_team_impact: Stacks with Drake Maye, your QB. Bench depth, not a starter.
targets.confidence_why: Half a game of role, with Romeo Doubs and DeMario Douglas splitting the same targets.
targets.competition: BrittAndTheBoys owns Brown and has the obvious replacement motive.
targets.bid: n/a -- watch who wins Brown's targets in Week 2

targets.hook: 55 of 56 snaps and 8 targets, the pivot if Douglas runs
targets.why: Played 55 of 56 snaps with a team-high 8 targets (3-53) in Week 1, per Sleeper's stat line, with a fraction of Douglas's attention (trending #57 against #2).
targets.my_team_impact: Same slot as Douglas; the pivot if Douglas goes to someone else.
targets.confidence_why: Volume without production in one game.
targets.competition: Nobody's roster points at him specifically.
targets.bid: n/a -- watch; backup to the Douglas claim

targets.hook: Flowers and Lane both hurt; 78% snaps but 1 target
targets.why: Zay Flowers (hamstring, day-to-day) and rookie Ja'Kobi Lane (fractured wrist, out weeks) both left Baltimore's Week 1 win; Bateman reclaims boundary duties (RotoWire, Sept. 14). Devontez Walker is now listed Out.
targets.confidence_why: The opportunity is an injury report, not a demonstrated role.
targets.competition: tyanserg (Flowers) and ColesMomPlays2Win (Lane) own the injured Ravens.
targets.bid: n/a -- watch the Ravens' Wednesday practice report

targets.hook: 32.4 pts in Week 1 shootout; plays at Atlanta next
targets.why: Threw for 361 yards and 3 TDs with a rushing score (32.4 pts) in the 59-37 loss to Chicago; 9.8 yards per attempt (FantasyPros, Sept. 15). Projects 16.0.
targets.asset: One huge game in a shootout; 16.0 projected
targets.my_team_impact: Below Maye, and below Stroud as a QB2 option.
targets.confidence_why: Stroud is the better QB2 if you want one.
targets.competition: LaPray0814 and WreckingCrew09 both need a QB.

targets.hook: Starts at Chicago if Murray doesn't clear the protocol
targets.why: Relieved Kyler Murray (concussion protocol) for 3 touchdowns in Week 1; Kevin O'Connell called Murray's Week 2 status day-by-day (Star Tribune, Sept. 14).
targets.asset: 19.2 pts in relief; a one-week streamer at most
targets.confidence_why: Nothing on your roster depends on this news.

targets.hook: 11.8 pts on 10 touches in a three-way committee
targets.why: Scored 11.8 on 6 carries and 4 targets over 25 of 69 snaps, per Sleeper's stat line, in a Giants backfield led by Cam Skattebo with Tyrone Tracy and Najee Harris also on hand (CBS Sports).
targets.my_team_impact: No path past White or Brooks.
targets.confidence_why: A 3.2 projection says the market is chasing one box score.
targets.competition: trentonwest33 (Mason questionable) and OrourkeP (Jacobs NA) are the RB-needy rosters.

targets.hook: Red-zone work with Kamara out; 9 carries, 1 TD
targets.why: With Alvin Kamara (knee) out, Miller took multiple red-zone touches and scored in Week 1 (RotoWire, Sept. 14): 9 carries for 30 yards on 26 of 90 snaps.
targets.my_team_impact: He's the backup to your own Travis Etienne, so there's a hedge case, but 4.7 projected doesn't justify a bench spot while Etienne is healthy.
targets.confidence_why: Etienne is the workhorse; Miller's role is goal-line scraps.
targets.competition: Kamara is unrostered here, so no rival owns this backfield's other half.

targets.hook: Led Bengals in targets on just 33% of snaps
targets.why: Led Cincinnati in catches, targets and yards with 5-78-1 on 7 targets against Tampa Bay (NBC Sports, CBS Sports, Sept. 13), on only 21 of 64 snaps.
targets.my_team_impact: Below both Likely (7.4) and Juwan Johnson (7.7).
targets.confidence_why: A one-third snap share won't hold seven targets.
targets.competition: tyanserg (Bowers Out) is the TE-needy roster.

targets.hook: Tied for team lead in targets in a run-heavy offense
targets.why: Tied for Pittsburgh's team lead in targets and accounted for nearly a quarter of Aaron Rodgers' passing yards in a run-heavy script (RotoWire, Sept. 14). 5-46-1 on 49 of 67 snaps.
targets.my_team_impact: Below both of your tight ends on projection.
targets.confidence_why: Roster fit, not a knock on the role.

targets.hook: Next up behind Judkins with Sampson out extended time
targets.why: Dylan Sampson left Cleveland's loss at Jacksonville on crutches with a knee injury expected to cost extended time; Sanders is next behind Quinshon Judkins (nfl-events feed, Sept. 14). Week 1: 1 carry, 3 targets on 18 of 51 snaps.
targets.asset: Change-of-pace role that just grew; projects 5.1
targets.confidence_why: Someone else's handcuff with no standalone role yet.
targets.competition: BrittAndTheBoys owns Judkins and is the natural handcuff bidder.

targets.hook: 6 targets; competes with your Johnston if McConkey sits
targets.why: Played 41 of 55 snaps for 6 targets (3-20), per Sleeper's stat line. Ladd McConkey is day-to-day with a rib injury after a hard hit in Week 1 (nfl-events feed, Sept. 14).
targets.my_team_impact: Not an add, but a flag: he and Quentin Johnston (your FLEX) split the same routes, so a McConkey absence helps Johnston less than it looks.
targets.confidence_why: Depends on McConkey's rib, which is unresolved.

targets.hook: 3 targets and a long TD; outranked by fuller roles
targets.why: Named San Francisco's WR3 with Christian Kirk (IR) and Ricky Pearsall out, then scored on a 39-yard catch in a 2-catch, 3-target Week 1 (NBC Sports, Sept. 10).
targets.my_team_impact: Douglas, Vele and Washington all project higher for the same slot.
targets.confidence_why: Relative value; nothing new about him.
targets.competition: No rival has a reason to prefer him.
